items.title: CrowdStrike Doubles Down on AI Agents With $495 Million in Deals After a Record $333 Million ARR Quarter
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrowdStrike agreed to buy Fiddler AI and Dreadnode, two AI agent security startups, for about $495 million, The Wall Street Journal reported. Net new ARR hit a record $333 million last quarter, up 51%, and CEO George Kurtz called it “the best quarter in CrowdStrike’s history.
